verdict: The original doodle is recognizable and the source crop and low, water-occluded crouch are substantially represented. The late head turn is not yet convincing enough to meet the source-pose bar; motion remains unapproved without normal-speed viewing.

same_drawing_identity.evidence: The polygonal body and long angular face, small lozenge eyes, simple mouth stroke and sparse black outline remain recognizably the supplied drawing. Hiding the legs and striped tail is consistent with this source interval's occlusion.

source_crop_pose.assessment: Crop and body placement broadly match; late head orientation is the main mismatch
source_crop_pose.evidence: All eight pairs retain the raccoon against the reed bank and near the same waterline. In pairs 06-08 the source face has turned into a left-facing profile, but the cartoon keeps essentially the same diagonally downward face plate used earlier, mainly losing an eye rather than turning the muzzle.

crouch_occlusion.evidence: The body stays low and rounded over the submerged underside; the snout lowers toward or into the foreground water. No unsupported full feet or exposed tail have been added.

motion.evidence: The eight paired samples show a coherent lowering, leftward turn and lateral reframing, but they cannot establish natural timing or the absence of in-between sliding or pops. Both MP4s decoded without errors.
motion.review_method: Viewed the source contact sheet, original design, and all eight key/source pairs; inspected video metadata and decoded both videos to a null sink. This was not actual normal-speed playback.

single_most_important_gap: The late face does not finish the source's left-facing profile turn; the unchanged diagonal face plate makes the animal read as a sliding drawing even though the body follows the source.
smallest_repair: Adjust only the head contour and facial feature positions through the turn into pairs 06-08: move the muzzle forward to the left, reduce the visible face width, and overlap the far-side features as the head turns. Preserve the supplied doodle's own angular construction and simple expression, and keep the existing low waterline occlusion. Then verify the full 2.79-second comparison at normal speed.
must_not_be_lost: The original angular face and polygonal body, sparse line economy, simple mouth and eye marks, source-matched crop and reed-bank placement, and the low crouch with hidden legs and tail. Do not add realistic raccoon markings or a new rendering style.
